_comment: Comprehensive Last War: Survival Game database: HQ levels 1-35 (Age of Oil), VS Alliance Duel, 4h Arms Race, 8 Major Alliance Events, 18 UR/SSR Heroes across Tank/Aircraft/Missile, Seasons 1-4, 8 Research Trees (T10 Special Forces & Age of Oil), Tactical Drone + Components + Skill Chips, UR/Mythic Gear Crafting, PvP Counter Guides, and Gift Codes.

vsDuelSchedule.name: Radar Training (Drone Boost)
vsDuelSchedule.tip: Stack Radar tasks on Sunday afternoon without claiming them until Monday 02:00 UTC reset!

vsDuelSchedule.name: Base Expansion (Construction)
vsDuelSchedule.tip: Leave finished buildings wrapped in gift-boxes until Tuesday reset before popping them!

vsDuelSchedule.name: Age of Science (Tech Research)
vsDuelSchedule.tip: Prioritize Alliance Duel Tech to 100% first so all future VS actions earn double points.

vsDuelSchedule.name: Train Heroes
vsDuelSchedule.tip: Sync Hero Advancement Arms Race window with Thursday VS Duel for double chest rewards.

vsDuelSchedule.name: Total Mobilization (Troops)
vsDuelSchedule.tip: Train lower-tier troops Mon-Thu, then promote them to your max tier during Friday Arms Race!

vsDuelSchedule.name: Enemy Buster (Kill Event)
vsDuelSchedule.tip: Never leave troops on your Wall unless you are a whale; shield up 10 minutes before 02:00 UTC!

Complete Tech Center nodes & use research speed-ups
Check in-game Arms Race preview for daily rotation shift

majorEvents.name: Capitol War & Server Warzone Duel
majorEvents.rewards: Honor Points (Mythic Red Blueprints), Conquest Coins, President Buffs, Diamonds
majorEvents.strategy: Fight inside the Grey Mud Zone with troops off your Wall! Farm Honor Points to buy Mythic Gear Blueprints in the Honor Store.

majorEvents.name: Desert Storm Battlefield (20v20)
majorEvents.rewards: 10,000+ Honor Points, Skill Medals, Universal UR Shards, Speed-ups
majorEvents.strategy: Zero permanent troop loss! Split into 3 squads: Hospital/Oil Well holders, Nuclear Silo main rally, and 2 fast Aircraft interceptors.

majorEvents.name: Winter Storm Battlefield (5v5 Solo Queue)
majorEvents.rewards: Honor Points, Drone Parts, Dielectric Ceramics, Gold Chests
majorEvents.strategy: Deliver supply crates and capture the central Bunker using your fastest march; earns massive weekly Honor Points.

majorEvents.name: Zombie Siege (Alliance Defense Waves 1–20)
majorEvents.rewards: Alliance Contribution, Valor Badges, Survivor Tokens, Speed-ups
majorEvents.strategy: Keep your main squad on the Wall and send your 2nd/3rd squads to reinforce lower-HQ alliance members so everyone survives Wave 20.

majorEvents.name: Marshall's Guard (Alliance Boss Rally)
majorEvents.rewards: UR Hero Shards, Drone Parts, Dielectric Ceramics, Alliance Chests
majorEvents.strategy: Call 1-minute rallies simultaneously so all online members can hit theLv.6–10 Marshall Guard before the 30-minute timer expires.

majorEvents.name: Zombies Invade & Gold Zombies
majorEvents.rewards: Courage Medals (Trade Store: UR Shards, Drone Parts, Stamina, Gold Chests)
majorEvents.strategy: Farm small Gold Zombies solo to spawn Doom Elites, then chain alliance rallies to clear out the entire Courage Medal shop!

urHeroes.name: Kimberly
urHeroes.note: #1 Priority UR Hero in Last War — max to 5★ first and unlock her Exclusive Weapon at HQ 21+ / Season 1 immediately.

urHeroes.name: Stetmann
urHeroes.note: Pairs with Kimberly and Marshall in the backline for the highest burst Tank squad.

urHeroes.name: Williams
urHeroes.note: Premier frontline Tank defender alongside Murphy; reduces all incoming energy and physical damage.

urHeroes.name: Murphy
urHeroes.note: F2P accessible frontline Tank anchor; Season 2 Exclusive Weapon adds backline damage reduction.

urHeroes.name: Marshall
urHeroes.note: Focuses your entire squad's fire onto the same target while boostingKimberly & Stetmann's Crit Rate.

urHeroes.name: Mason (UR Promotion)
urHeroes.note: Upgrades from 5★ SSR to UR in Season 1! All Wall of Honor shards refund via mail on Thursday VS Hero Day for millions of points.

urHeroes.name: Violet (UR Promotion)
urHeroes.note: Upgrades from 5★ SSR to UR in Season 2; great F2P frontline tank if you don't have Williams.

urHeroes.name: Scarlett (UR Promotion)
urHeroes.note: Upgrades from SSR to UR in Season 3 for huge Thursday VS Alliance Duel points.

urHeroes.name: DVA
urHeroes.note: Core hypercarry of the Aircraft meta squad (counters Tank squads by +20%); unlock her Exclusive Weapon in Season 1.

urHeroes.name: Lucius
urHeroes.note: Grants massive energy damage resistance, completely neutralizing enemy Kimberly Tank squads.

urHeroes.name: Carlie
urHeroes.note: Frontline Aircraft tank; her Season 2 Exclusive Weapon makes her nearly untouchable against Tank and Aircraft teams.

urHeroes.name: Morrison
urHeroes.note: Deals physical damage on an Aircraft team and shreds enemy defense so DVA can wipe the mirror Aircraft matchup.

urHeroes.name: Schuyler
urHeroes.note: Stuns multiple enemy heroes in the backline; Season 3 Exclusive Weapon makes her a PvP nightmare.

urHeroes.name: Tesla
urHeroes.note: Core carry for Missile squads (counters Aircraft formations by +20%); Season 1 Exclusive Weapon.

urHeroes.name: Swift
urHeroes.note: Targets lowest-HP enemy units; Season 2 Exclusive Weapon makes Missile squads lethal against Aircraft whales.

urHeroes.name: McGregor
urHeroes.note: Taunts enemy DPS away from Tesla and Fiona while absorbing massive burst damage.

urHeroes.name: Fiona
urHeroes.note: Stacks multi-hit radiation damage alongside Tesla and Swift.

urHeroes.name: Adam
urHeroes.note: Grants counter-attack state to your frontline Missile defenders, shredding rapid-fire Aircraft squads.

B-2 Stealth Bomber Skin (151+ requires parts every level)

droneComponents.effect: Boosts Drone Attack Rate, Crit Rate & Skill Damage Reduction — far more impactful in PvP than flat stats.
Provides flat Hero Attack, Defense, and HP bonuses; open Left/Right choice chests only for Right-Side Lv.8/Lv.9 breakpoints!

seasons.name: Season 1: The Crimson Plague
seasons.mechanic: Protein Farms & Virus Research Institute (Virus Resistance)
seasons.summary: Build Virus Resistance via Protein Farms and Mutant Crystals to capture higher-tier infected strongholds, promote Mason to UR, and battle across neighbor Warzone maps.

seasons.name: Season 2: Polar World
seasons.mechanic: Titanium Alloy Factory & High-Heat Furnace (-60°C Blizzard Survival)
seasons.summary: Manage base temperature during blizzards, upgrade your High-Heat Furnace with Coal/Titanium, promote Violet to UR, and unlock the Age of Oil tech tree afterward.

seasons.name: Post-Season 2: Age of Oil (HQ 31–35)
seasons.mechanic: Oil Wells, Age of Oil Tech Tree & +1 Build/Tech Queue
seasons.summary: Research the Age of Oil tree (requires 40% completion to unlock Oil Wells and the HQ 31–35 Prerequisite node) before spending Iron/Gold on HQ 31.

seasons.name: Season 3: Golden Realm
seasons.summary: Cleanse desert miasma, convert green tiles around Alliance Centers, promote Scarlett to UR, and push T10 Special Forces + Exclusive Weapon Lv.20+ milestones.

seasons.name: Season 4: Evernight Isle
seasons.mechanic: Optoelectronic Lab, Quartz & Blood Moon Nightfall
seasons.summary: Maintain Lighthouse illumination during Blood Moon eclipses, upgrade Optoelectronic nodes, and unlock Stetmann and Lucius Exclusive Weapons.

researchTrees.name: Alliance Duel (VS) Tech Tree
researchTrees.summary: Unlocks Chests 7–9 in daily VS Alliance Duel and doubles all VS points earned. Max this to 100% before touching Special Forces.

researchTrees.name: Special Forces (T10 Troops Unlock)
researchTrees.unlock: Tech Center Lv. 26 (T10 requires Tech Center Lv. 30)
researchTrees.summary: Only research the minimum path (40% overall completion) down to the bottom 4 nodes (Advanced Protection, Boost Attack, Boost Health, Boost Defense to Lv.10) to unlock T10 Units!

researchTrees.name: Age of Oil Tech Tree (HQ 31–35 Gate)
researchTrees.summary: Unlocks the 2nd Free Tech Queue, +1 Extra Hospital, 3rd Oil Well, and the mandatory HQ 31–35 Upper Limit node at the bottom.

researchTrees.name: Units Tech Tree
researchTrees.summary: Huge raw Attack, HP, Defense, and Load Capacity scaling across all squads without consuming Valor Badges.

researchTrees.name: Hero Tech Tree
researchTrees.summary: Focus exclusively on your main squad branch (Tank, Aircraft, or Missile) plus the bottom All-Hero nodes.

researchTrees.name: Siege to Seize & Defense Fortifications
researchTrees.summary: Grants massive March Size and Damage Reduction when attacking enemy bases or defending garrisons in Capitol War and Desert Storm.

pvpStrategies.title: The Counter Triangle (+20% / -20% Damage Modifier)
pvpStrategies.details: Tank beats Missile (+20% DMG dealt / -20% DMG taken) → Missile beats Aircraft → Aircraft beats Tank. Because 80% of F2P/low-spenders run Tank Squad 1 (Kimberly + Stetmann), mid-spenders pivot to Aircraft (DVA + Lucius + Carlie) in Season 1, while endgame whales build Missile (Tesla + Swift + Adam) to snipe Aircraft squads.

pvpStrategies.title: 5-of-a-Kind Squad Aura (+20% ATK / HP / DEF)
pvpStrategies.details: Running 5 heroes of the same vehicle type (e.g., 5 Tanks or 5 Aircraft) activates the maximum +20% Attack, +20% HP, and +20% Defense squad aura. Always place your 2 Tank/Defense heroes in the Front Row and your 2 Attackers + 1 Support (Marshall/Schuyler) in the Back Row.

pvpStrategies.title: Capitol War & Saturday Enemy Buster Wall Toggle
pvpStrategies.details: Uncheck Squads 1, 2, and 3 from your Base Defense Wall before teleporting into the Capitol Mud Zone or Enemy Buster warzone! If your base is zeroed while your squads are unchecked from the Wall, you lose only ~400 Drill Ground troops instead of losing 25,000+ troops into the Hospital.

pvpStrategies.title: Mythic Red Gear Blueprint Priority (Radar vs. Railgun)
pvpStrategies.details: Your first 10 Mythic Gear Blueprints (from Season Store, Honor Points, or Ammo Bonanza) should go either to Kimberly/DVA's Thor Railgun (for World Boss & PvP burst) OR to your frontline defender's Predator Radar (which cuts enemy Crit and Energy damage by 30%).
